description: This source file provides utility functions for resolving and spawning a pnpm command runner, tailored for cross-platform (Windows and Unix) environments. It handles command escaping on Windows and determines the correct command and arguments to execute pnpm scripts.

methods.name: resolvePnpmRunner
methods.description: Determines the appropriate command and arguments to run pnpm, considering environment variables, platform, and pnpm executable path.

methods.name: createPnpmRunnerSpawnSpec
methods.description: Creates a spawn specification object for executing the resolved pnpm command with specified parameters.

methods.name: spawnPnpmRunner
methods.description: Spawns a child process to run pnpm with the given parameters using the spawn method from 'child_process'.
